introduction: The tool result tracing system extends the `AgentTraceSink` audit infrastructure to capture tool outputs returned to the model after execution, completing the full model call audit trail in `.agent-fox/audit/agent_{run_id}.jsonl`.

glossary.AgentTraceSink: The audit sink that writes structured trace events to a per-run JSONL file in the audit directory
glossary.ClaudeBackend: The backend implementation that drives the Claude model via the claude_agent_sdk, handling hooks and tool lifecycle
glossary.HookMatcher: A claude_agent_sdk type that wraps one or more hook callables for registration in the hooks dict
glossary.PostToolUse: The claude_agent_sdk hook event fired after a tool successfully executes and returns a response
glossary.PostToolUseFailure: The existing claude_agent_sdk hook event fired when a tool execution raises an exception
glossary.PostToolUseHookInput: The dataclass provided by claude_agent_sdk to PostToolUse hook handlers, containing tool_name, tool_input, tool_response, and tool_use_id
glossary.SinkDispatcher: The multiplexer that fans out sink method calls to all registered sinks
glossary._dispatch_optional: A SinkDispatcher helper that calls a named method on each registered sink only if that sink implements it
glossary._execute_query: The function in session.py that orchestrates a single query execution, passing callbacks to the backend
glossary._write_event: A private AgentTraceSink helper that serializes and appends a trace event dict to the run's JSONL file
glossary.afaudit: The internal Python package (packages/afaudit/) that provides AgentTraceSink, SinkDispatcher, and related audit infrastructure
glossary.audit JSONL file: The per-run file at .agent-fox/audit/agent_{run_id}.jsonl where all trace events are appended
glossary.node_id: An identifier for the agent node within a run, used to correlate trace events
glossary.run_id: A unique identifier for a single agent session run, used to name the audit JSONL file
glossary.tool.result: The trace event type written to the audit JSONL file to record a tool's output
glossary.tool.use: The existing trace event type written to the audit JSONL file to record a tool invocation and its input
glossary.tool_error_callback: An existing callable passed to ClaudeBackend.execute() that is invoked when a tool execution fails
glossary.tool_response: The output value returned by a tool to the model, typed as Any in the SDK and serialized to JSON for storage
glossary.tool_result_callback: A callable passed to ClaudeBackend.execute() that is invoked with tool result data after each successful tool execution
glossary.tool_use_id: The unique identifier assigned by the SDK to a specific tool invocation, correlating tool.use and tool.result events
glossary.truncate_tool_input: An existing utility function that truncates a string to a maximum length with a trailing marker

user_story.goal: see what each tool returned to the model in the audit trace
user_story.benefit: I can reconstruct the full conversation including tool feedback without re-running the session

acceptance_criteria.action: serialize tool_response via json.dumps with default=str, truncate to 50000 chars using the same pattern as `truncate_tool_input`, then call `_write_event` with event_type 'tool.result' and the assembled data dict
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; the audit JSONL file gains one appended line containing the tool.result event JSON
acceptance_criteria.trigger: record_tool_result is called on AgentTraceSink with run_id, node_id, tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response

acceptance_criteria.action: write tool.result events with the schema: event_type, run_id, timestamp (ISO 8601), node_id, tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response (JSON-serialized string, max 50000 chars)
truncate the serialized tool_response to exactly 50000 characters and append ' [truncated]' to the stored value
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the tool_response field in the written event is exactly 50000 chars followed by ' [truncated]'
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a tool_response string exceeds 50000 characters after JSON serialization

edge_cases.action: use the default=str fallback in json.dumps to coerce the value to a string representation without raising, then proceed with truncation and write
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; event is still written with a string-coerced tool_response value
edge_cases.error_condition: tool_response is None or an unexpected type that json.dumps cannot serialize normally

edge_cases.action: serialize the empty value normally (e.g. '""' or '{}' or '[]') and write the event without special-casing
edge_cases.return_contract: returns None; event is written with the serialized empty value
edge_cases.error_condition: tool_response is an empty string or empty dict/list

edge_cases.action: allow the exception to propagate to the caller; no silent swallowing at this layer
edge_cases.error_condition: the underlying `_write_event` call raises an IOError (e.g. disk full)

user_story.goal: have tool result recording fan out to all registered sinks that support it
user_story.benefit: future sinks can opt in to tool result recording without changes to the dispatch layer

acceptance_criteria.action: call `_dispatch_optional` with method name 'record_tool_result' and all provided keyword arguments, forwarding them to every registered sink that implements the method
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; sinks that implement record_tool_result receive the call, sinks that do not implement it are silently skipped
acceptance_criteria.trigger: record_tool_result is called on SinkDispatcher with keyword arguments run_id, node_id, tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response

acceptance_criteria.action: complete the dispatch call without error via `_dispatch_optional`'s existing skip-if-absent behavior
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None with no exception raised
acceptance_criteria.state: no sink registered in SinkDispatcher implements record_tool_result

edge_cases.action: follow the existing `_dispatch_optional` error handling behavior (log and continue or propagate, consistent with how other optional dispatch errors are handled)
edge_cases.return_contract: behavior is consistent with existing _dispatch_optional error semantics
edge_cases.error_condition: one registered sink's record_tool_result raises an exception during dispatch

user_story.goal: pass a callback into ClaudeBackend.execute that is invoked after each successful tool call
user_story.benefit: the session layer can record tool results without coupling the backend to audit infrastructure

acceptance_criteria.action: register a PostToolUse hook via hooks['PostToolUse'] = [HookMatcher(hooks=[_build_tool_result_hook(tool_result_callback)])] following the same pattern as the existing tool_error_callback / PostToolUseFailure registration
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None at registration time; the hook is invoked by the SDK after each successful tool execution
acceptance_criteria.trigger: ClaudeBackend.execute() is called with a non-None tool_result_callback

acceptance_criteria.action: invoke tool_result_callback with the tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response extracted from the PostToolUseHookInput
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; callback is called synchronously within the hook handler
acceptance_criteria.trigger: the PostToolUse SDK hook fires with a PostToolUseHookInput containing tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response

acceptance_criteria.action: skip PostToolUse hook registration entirely; no hooks['PostToolUse'] key is set
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; no PostToolUse hook is registered

edge_cases.action: catch the exception inside the hook handler, log a WARNING with the error details, and allow the SDK to continue session execution without interruption
edge_cases.return_contract: session execution continues; a WARNING is emitted to the log; the exception is not re-raised
edge_cases.error_condition: the tool_result_callback raises an exception during the PostToolUse hook invocation

edge_cases.action: catch any AttributeError or KeyError when extracting fields, log a WARNING, and return from the hook without calling tool_result_callback
edge_cases.return_contract: session execution continues; a WARNING is emitted; tool_result_callback is not called for the malformed event
edge_cases.error_condition: the PostToolUseHookInput received by the hook has an unexpected shape or missing fields

edge_cases.action: never register a PostToolUse hook for backends other than ClaudeBackend (deepagents, google_adk); the tool_result_callback parameter is exclusive to ClaudeBackend.execute()

user_story.goal: have tool results automatically recorded in the audit trace during a session
user_story.benefit: I get a complete audit trail without any manual configuration beyond enabling --audit

acceptance_criteria.action: construct a tool_result_callback lambda/closure that calls sink_dispatcher.record_tool_result(run_id=run_id, node_id=node_id, tool_name=tool_name, tool_use_id=tool_use_id, tool_response=tool_response) and pass it to ClaudeBackend.execute() as the tool_result_callback argument
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None at wiring time; tool results are recorded in the audit JSONL file after each tool execution
acceptance_criteria.trigger: _execute_query() is called with an active SinkDispatcher that has AgentTraceSink registered

acceptance_criteria.action: pass tool_result_callback=None to ClaudeBackend.execute(), mirroring the existing pattern for tool_error_callback when audit is inactive
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: returns None; no PostToolUse hook is registered and no tool.result events are written
acceptance_criteria.state: --audit is not active and AgentTraceSink is not registered in SinkDispatcher

edge_cases.action: the exception propagates to the ClaudeBackend hook handler (05-REQ-3.E1), which catches it, logs a WARNING, and continues; _execute_query itself does not add additional error handling for this path
edge_cases.return_contract: session execution continues; WARNING is logged by the hook handler layer
edge_cases.error_condition: sink_dispatcher.record_tool_result raises an exception inside the tool_result_callback

edge_cases.action: raise a ValueError at callback construction time (before execute() is called) with a descriptive message indicating which identifier is missing
edge_cases.return_contract: raises ValueError before ClaudeBackend.execute() is called
edge_cases.error_condition: run_id or node_id is not available in the _execute_query closure scope when the callback is constructed

requirements.title: End-to-end tool result audit trail when --audit is active

user_story.goal: see a complete sequence of tool.use followed by tool.result events in the audit file
user_story.benefit: I can reconstruct exactly what the model sent to each tool and what it received back

acceptance_criteria.action: append a tool.result event to the audit JSONL file with matching tool_name and tool_use_id, appearing after the corresponding tool.use event in the file
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the audit JSONL file contains a tool.result line with non-empty tool_response, tool_name matching the tool.use event, and tool_use_id matching the tool.use event
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a tool executes successfully during a session
acceptance_criteria.condition: --audit is active and AgentTraceSink is registered in SinkDispatcher

acceptance_criteria.action: write one tool.result event per tool invocation, each with a unique tool_use_id correlating to its tool.use event
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: the audit JSONL file contains exactly one tool.result event for each tool.use event, with matching tool_use_id values
acceptance_criteria.trigger: a session completes with multiple tool calls

acceptance_criteria.action: write no tool.result events to any file
acceptance_criteria.return_contract: no tool.result lines appear in any file; no audit JSONL file is created solely for tool results

edge_cases.action: truncate the tool_response field to exactly 50000 characters and append ' [truncated]' before writing the tool.result event
edge_cases.return_contract: the tool_response field in the written event is exactly 50000 chars + ' [truncated]'; the session is not interrupted
edge_cases.error_condition: a tool returns a response larger than 50000 characters when JSON-serialized

edge_cases.action: write a tool.error event via the existing tool_error_callback path; do not write a tool.result event for the failed invocation
edge_cases.return_contract: the audit JSONL file contains a tool.error event but no tool.result event for the failed tool call
edge_cases.error_condition: a tool execution fails (PostToolUseFailure fires instead of PostToolUse)

correctness_properties.title: tool.result event appears after tool.use in audit file
correctness_properties.invariant: the `tool.result` event with a given `tool_use_id` appears after the `tool.use` event with the same `tool_use_id` in the `audit JSONL file`

correctness_properties.title: tool_use_id correlation between tool.use and tool.result
correctness_properties.for_any: pair of tool.use and tool.result events in the audit JSONL file
correctness_properties.invariant: the `tool_use_id` field in the `tool.result` event equals the `tool_use_id` field in the corresponding `tool.use` event

correctness_properties.title: tool_response never exceeds truncation limit
correctness_properties.for_any: tool.result event written to the audit JSONL file
correctness_properties.invariant: the length of the tool_response string in the written event is at most 50000 + len(' [truncated]') characters

correctness_properties.title: No tool.result events when --audit is inactive
correctness_properties.invariant: no file in the filesystem contains a line with event_type equal to 'tool.result' attributable to that run

correctness_properties.title: Hook failure does not terminate session
correctness_properties.for_any: exception raised inside the PostToolUse hook handler
correctness_properties.invariant: the session continues to completion and subsequent tool calls are executed; the exception is logged as a WARNING and not re-raised

correctness_properties.title: One tool.result per tool.use
correctness_properties.for_any: session with N successful tool invocations under --audit
correctness_properties.invariant: the `audit JSONL file` contains exactly N `tool.result` events

correctness_properties.title: json.dumps default=str never raises on tool_response
correctness_properties.for_any: value of tool_response passed to AgentTraceSink.record_tool_result
correctness_properties.invariant: json.dumps(tool_response, default=str) completes without raising a TypeError regardless of the runtime type of tool_response

execution_paths.title: Happy path: tool result recorded in audit JSONL during --audit session

steps.action: launches nightshift daemon with --audit flag, starting a session
constructs a tool_result_callback closure capturing run_id, node_id, and sink_dispatcher, then passes it to ClaudeBackend.execute()
registers a PostToolUse hook via HookMatcher wrapping the tool_result_callback, alongside the existing PostToolUseFailure and PreToolUse hooks
executes a tool and fires the PostToolUse hook with a PostToolUseHookInput containing tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response
extracts tool_name, tool_use_id, and tool_response from PostToolUseHookInput and invokes tool_result_callback with those values
calls sink_dispatcher.record_tool_result(run_id=run_id, node_id=node_id, tool_name=tool_name, tool_use_id=tool_use_id, tool_response=tool_response)
calls _dispatch_optional('record_tool_result', ...) which forwards the call to AgentTraceSink.record_tool_result()
JSON-serializes tool_response with default=str, truncates to 50000 chars if needed, then calls _write_event with event_type='tool.result' and the assembled data dict
receives one appended line containing the tool.result event JSON, completing the audit trail for that tool invocation

execution_paths.title: Hook failure path: serialization error does not interrupt session

steps.action: fires PostToolUse hook after a tool execution
invokes tool_result_callback, which raises an exception (e.g. IOError from _write_event)
catches the exception, emits a WARNING log entry with the error details, and returns from the hook without re-raising
continues session execution as if the hook succeeded; subsequent tool calls and model turns proceed normally

execution_paths.title: No --audit: tool_result_callback is None, no hook registered

steps.action: launches nightshift daemon without --audit flag
determines AgentTraceSink is not registered in SinkDispatcher and passes tool_result_callback=None to ClaudeBackend.execute()
skips PostToolUse hook registration because tool_result_callback is None
executes tools normally; PostToolUse hook is never fired to any handler

execution_paths.title: Large tool response truncated before writing

steps.action: fires PostToolUse hook with a tool_response that serializes to more than 50000 characters
invokes tool_result_callback with the raw tool_response value
JSON-serializes tool_response to a string exceeding 50000 chars, then truncates to exactly 50000 chars and appends ' [truncated]'
receives the tool.result event with the truncated tool_response field, preventing trace file bloat

error_handling.condition: tool_result_callback raises any exception during the PostToolUse hook invocation
error_handling.behavior: ClaudeBackend hook handler catches the exception, emits a WARNING log entry with the error details, and returns from the hook without re-raising; session execution continues normally

error_handling.condition: PostToolUseHookInput has an unexpected shape or missing fields when the hook handler tries to extract tool_name, tool_use_id, or tool_response
error_handling.behavior: ClaudeBackend hook handler catches AttributeError or KeyError, logs a WARNING, and returns without calling tool_result_callback

error_handling.condition: tool_response is None or an unserializable type
error_handling.behavior: AgentTraceSink.record_tool_result uses json.dumps with default=str to coerce the value to a string without raising; the event is written with the coerced string value

error_handling.condition: _write_event raises an IOError (e.g. disk full) inside AgentTraceSink.record_tool_result
error_handling.behavior: the IOError propagates to the caller (the tool_result_callback closure), which propagates it to the ClaudeBackend hook handler (05-ERR-1), which catches it and logs a WARNING

error_handling.condition: run_id or node_id is not available in the _execute_query closure scope when tool_result_callback is constructed
error_handling.behavior: session.py raises a ValueError before ClaudeBackend.execute() is called, with a descriptive message indicating which identifier is missing

error_handling.condition: a tool execution fails and PostToolUseFailure fires instead of PostToolUse
error_handling.behavior: the existing tool_error_callback path writes a tool.error event; no tool.result event is written for the failed invocation
